title: hebe × affinis
intro: Hebe × affinis, commonly known as the 'Great Orme' or 'Evergreen Hebe', is a hybrid plant species within the hebe genus, known for its attractive foliage and vibrant flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Hebe × affinis are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety, while also exhibiting antioxidant properties that may protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Hebe × affinis include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential applications in modern medicine.
